blocks.text: The Sandiganbayan’s Fifth Division has dismissed Sen. Jinggoy Estrada’s motion for reconsideration on his 90-day suspension for lack of merit. Estrada is detained for alleged plunder said to involve P573 million in kickbacks from government infrastructure projects.
